description: This script provides utility functions for SNMP operations, including fetching model number, firmware version, and MAC address, and setting environment variables for SNMP client queries.

methods.name: setSNMPEnv
methods.description: Sets environment variables needed for SNMP client queries, including MIBS, MIBDIRS, PATH, and LD_LIBRARY_PATH.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves the device model number from /etc/device.properties.

methods.name: getFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Obtains the device firmware version by executing an SNMP GET for sysDescr.0 and formatting the output.

methods.name: getECMMac
methods.description: Gets the MAC address of the device from SNMP walk on IF-MIB::ifPhysAddress.2.
